extends SceneTree

# Bus inner class — RefCounted with signal pulse (0 args).
class Bus extends RefCounted:
	signal pulse

var sched: FrameScheduler = FrameScheduler.new()
var events: Array = []
var gate = {"open": false}
var bus: Bus = Bus.new()

func _done(task_name) -> void:
	events.append("%d|%s|complete" % [sched.current_frame, task_name])

func task_a() -> void:
	events.append("%d|A|start" % sched.current_frame)
	await sched.wait_frames(2)
	events.append("%d|A|resume" % sched.current_frame)
	await sched.wait_frames(2)
	events.append("%d|A|end" % sched.current_frame)

func task_b() -> void:
	events.append("%d|B|start" % sched.current_frame)
	await sched.wait_frames(1)
	events.append("%d|B|open_gate" % sched.current_frame)
	gate.open = true
	await sched.wait_frames(2)
	events.append("%d|B|pulse" % sched.current_frame)
	bus.pulse.emit()

func task_c() -> void:
	events.append("%d|C|start" % sched.current_frame)
	await sched.wait_until(func(): return gate.open)
	events.append("%d|C|gate_opened" % sched.current_frame)

func task_d() -> void:
	events.append("%d|D|start" % sched.current_frame)
	await sched.wait_signal(bus.pulse)
	events.append("%d|D|pulsed" % sched.current_frame)
	await sched.wait_frames(1)
	events.append("%d|D|end" % sched.current_frame)

func _init() -> void:
	sched.spawn("A", Callable(self, "task_a"), Callable(self, "_done"))
	sched.spawn("B", Callable(self, "task_b"), Callable(self, "_done"))
	sched.spawn("C", Callable(self, "task_c"), Callable(self, "_done"))
	sched.spawn("D", Callable(self, "task_d"), Callable(self, "_done"))

	sched.advance(7)

	var expected = [
		"0|A|start",
		"0|B|start",
		"0|C|start",
		"0|D|start",
		"1|B|open_gate",
		"1|C|gate_opened",
		"1|C|complete",
		"2|A|resume",
		"3|B|pulse",
		"3|B|complete",
		"3|D|pulsed",
		"4|A|end",
		"4|A|complete",
		"4|D|end",
		"4|D|complete",
	]

	var ok = (events == expected)
	if not ok:
		print("FAILED. Got:")
		for e in events:
			print("  ", e)
		print("Expected:")
		for e in expected:
			print("  ", e)
	else:
		print("ALL MATCH!")
		print("Events:")
		for e in events:
			print("  ", e)

	# Return a non-zero exit code if we didn't get all expected events.
	OS.exit_code = 0 if ok else 1
	quit()
